headlines: Chip and AI-cloud names lead the slide: SOXL -11.9%, AVGO -4.9%, NVDA -3.0%, CIFR -8.1%, IREN -7.5%, QQQ -1.5% while IWM is only -0.2%
TLT +0.9% and GLD +0.5%: bonds and gold bid
Stocktwits chatter still blames OpenAI revenue disclosures (unconfirmed); one poster calls the gap a gross-vs-net revenue presentation difference

rumors.text: OpenAI reportedly told investors annualised revenue is near $50B versus about $70B reported earlier; a counter-view says the gap is gross vs net revenue accounting and total demand is unchanged
rumors.why: An AI-demand disappointment would keep pressure on chip and AI-capex names and the Nasdaq-heavy index; an accounting-only explanation would fade the selloff

rumors.text: Posters expect SPY to pump into the close and call the dip a buy
rumors.why: Dip-buying and short covering could lift the index into the close

plays.reason: Tech-led weakness with bonds and gold bid, but SPY is only -0.6% and the crowd is already leaning to dip-buying, so edge is thin

readings.whats_new: SPY is little changed from an hour ago at about 772.7 (-0.58%) while QQQ is -1.5% and semis fell harder (SOXL -11.9%, AVGO -4.9%, NVDA -3.0%). Fear and greed is 38 (fear), VIX steady near 15.5. The OpenAI revenue story is being re-shared with a new gross-vs-net accounting counterargument; the crowd stays bullish and calls for a late pump.
